advisory_boundary: This detector is advisory. It may raise REVIEW or open an investigation. It cannot ALLOW, cannot issue a capability, cannot override the controller or a revocation, and cannot create trusted evidence.

baseline_without_ml_mismatch_feature.model: deterministic weighted feature score, classifier feature ablated

candidate.model: IsolationForest(n_estimators=200), fitted on the ordinary training control and scored on disjoint held-out rows

circularity_note: Seven of the eight defect classes flip a field the deterministic features already watch, so a high baseline score on those proves the features fire and nothing more. CATEGORY_LAUNDERED is the non-circular case - it moves title and description only, leaving brand, category, price, merchant and every identifier untouched - and category_laundering_ablation is the result that actually matters.

controls.note: Disjoint by construction. Every metric in this report is scored on the ordinary evaluation control plus the defective rows; the learned candidate is fitted only on the ordinary training control.

decision_reason: The learned detector did not improve the frozen evaluation by more than the threshold, so it is not shipped. The deterministic analytics stands.
scope_limit: Defects are injected by this harness. A detector that finds them is not thereby shown to find fraud in production traffic.
